title: HTML5 Canvas Bullet Hell Shooter (打飞机游戏)
description: A complete single-file HTML5 Canvas shooting game featuring a player ship, waves of enemies, a boss fight with configurable danmaku (bullet hell) patterns, and a power-up system with specific weapon types (Apple, Chicken, Grape, Lemon).

nodes.title: Core Game Loop & Structure
nodes.details: Set up the HTML5 Canvas context (full window or 800x600), main game loop using requestAnimationFrame, and state management (Start, Playing, GameOver). Handle window resizing events.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file contains a <canvas> element.
Canvas context is initialized.
Game loop (update/draw) runs via requestAnimationFrame.
State switching (start/gameover) logic exists.

nodes.title: Player Controller & Rendering
nodes.details: Implement the Player entity: triangle/ship shape. Controls: Arrow Keys or A/D for movement (smooth). Auto-firing mechanism (cooldown based). Player has HP (default 3) and a short iframe (invulnerability) after being hit.
acceptance_criteria: Player moves left/right within canvas bounds.
Player shoots bullets upwards automatically.
Hit detection reduces HP.
Player flashes/invulnerable for 1s after hit.

nodes.title: Enemy Spawning & Movement
nodes.details: Create Enemy class: spawns at random X at top, moves down. HP 1-3. On death -> explode (particle) + score increase. Spawn rate increases over time/difficulty.
acceptance_criteria: Enemies spawn continuously at the top.
Enemies collide with Player bullets and take damage.
Enemies collide with Player -> Player takes damage.
Score increases on enemy kill.

nodes.title: Boss & Danmaku System
nodes.details: Implement Boss Entity: High HP. Appears every X seconds or Score threshold. Movement: Enters top, hovers/sine-wave. Danmaku System: 1) Spread (fan shape), 2) Ring (circle out), 3) Spiral (angle += speed), 4) Homing (updates vector toward player). Uses trigonometry for bullet vectors.
acceptance_criteria: Boss appears with full HP bar.
Boss fires patterns: Spread, Ring, Spiral, Homing.
Boss cycles patterns every few seconds.
Defeating Boss gives large score bonus.

nodes.title: Power-up System
nodes.details: Implement 4 specific powerups dropped by enemies/boss: 1) Apple (Spread Shot: 3-way front), 2) Chicken (Shotgun: 5-9 random spread), 3) Grape (Pierce: passes through 2-3 enemies), 4) Lemon (Laser: high damage beam). Each lasts 8s. UI shows active weapon name & timer.
acceptance_criteria: Enemies drop items: Apple, Chicken, Grape, Lemon.
Item collision updates Player weapon state.
Apple fires 3 bullets. Chicken fires 5-9 spread. Grape pierces. Lemon fires beam.
Weapon effect expires after 8s and reverts to default.

nodes.title: Visual Effects, Particles & UI
nodes.details: Particle System for explosions. HUD overlay: Score (top left), HP (hearts or bar), Boss HP Bar (top center, conditional), Active Power-up (bottom right with text). Start Screen & Game Over Screen with Restart button.
acceptance_criteria: Explosions spawn on enemy death.
HUD displays Score, HP, Weapon status.
Boss HP bar only visible when Boss is active.
Start/Game Over screens are functional.

nodes.title: Final Integration & Tuning
nodes.details: Aggregate all JS classes into a single <script> block within index.html. Ensure no external file references. Tune game balance: spawn rates, boss timing, power-up duration (e.g. 8s). Add instructional text (Move: Arrows, Auto-fire).
acceptance_criteria: Deliverable is a single .html file.
File runs directly in browser (no build step).
Game balance is playable (difficulty ramps).
Instructions included.
